name: CD4046B
description: Micropower CMOS phase-locked loop containing a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO), a source follower, a zener diode, and two independent phase comparators sharing a common signal input and comparator input. Wide supply range (3V-18V), low power. Common building block in frequency synthesis, FM demodulation, tone decoding, and (in the synth/pedal world) VCO and frequency-multiplier circuits.

pins.name: PCPOUT
pins.description: phase pulses output; a lock-indicator/edge signal, distinct from phase comparator I's main output on pin 2

pins.name: PC1OUT
pins.description: phase comparator I output (XOR-type comparator, drives the loop filter)

pins.name: COMPIN
pins.description: comparator input (feedback signal for phase comparison)

pins.name: INHIBIT
pins.description: inhibit; disables VCO and source follower when high, for power saving

pins.name: C1A
pins.description: external timing capacitor terminal A (VCO frequency-setting)

pins.name: C1B
pins.description: external timing capacitor terminal B (VCO frequency-setting)

pins.name: VCOIN
pins.description: VCO control voltage input (from the loop filter)

pins.name: ZENER
pins.description: on-chip zener diode terminal, used for the demodulator's source-follower reference

DIP-16.notes: Per the CD4046BC connection diagram, DIP-16, top view: PHASE PULSES=1, PHASE COMP I OUT=2, COMPARATOR IN=3, VCO OUT=4, INHIBIT=5, C1A=6, C1B=7, VSS=8, VCO IN=9, DEMODULATOR OUT=10, R1=11, R2=12, PHASE COMP II OUT=13, SIGNAL IN=14, ZENER=15, VDD=16.

extra.VCO_freq: 1.3MHz typ @ VDD=10V (external R1/C1 dependent; see the datasheet's VCO frequency-vs-Vin curves)
extra.phase_comparators: two independent phase comparators (PC1: XOR-type, works with 50% duty cycle signals; PC2: edge-triggered, works with any duty cycle and offers zero phase/frequency offset at lock)

typical_application: Frequency synthesis, clock recovery, FM demodulation, tone decoding, and in synth/pedal circuits: voltage-controlled oscillators, frequency doublers, and frequency-to-voltage-adjacent tricks that reuse the VCO or phase comparators alone.
gotchas: the VCO (pins 4/6/7/9/11/12) and the phase comparators (pins 1/2/3/13/14) can be used independently; many synth/pedal circuits use only the VCO half and leave the PLL loop unconnected
R1 sets the VCO's basic frequency range, R2 (optional) sets a frequency offset; omitting R2 is fine but changes the tuning equation, follow the datasheet's formula for the topology actually used
PC1 (XOR-type) needs roughly 50% duty cycle inputs to lock cleanly; PC2 (edge-triggered) is more tolerant of duty cycle but responds differently to noise, pick based on the actual signal
INHIBIT (pin 5) powers down the VCO and source follower; leave it low for continuous operation, do not float
